response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and a diverse technical background, but his experience with C++ and industrial automation is limited compared to the role's core requirements. His expertise in secure coding, event-driven architectures, and mentorship aligns partially with the job, but a deeper evaluation is needed to assess his fit for high-performance C++ systems and industrial cybersecurity standards.
strengths: Extensive experience with secure coding practices and event-driven architectures (e.g., GISCollective platform, micro-services at Sociomantic).
Proven mentorship and knowledge-sharing abilities (workshops, talks, and community contributions).
Diverse technical background with exposure to multi-threaded systems and low-latency applications (e.g., DLang at Sociomantic).
concerns: Limited recent hands-on experience with C++ (last notable C++ role was in 2014–2015 at National Instruments).
No explicit mention of industrial automation, IoT protocols (e.g., MQTT, OPC UA), or IEC 62443 standards in resume.
Primary expertise lies in web/mobile development (TypeScript, Node.js, React), which is not the focus of this role.
